INSERT INTO ttokssaemdb.masterplan ( branchid, memberid, dayofweek, method, hour, sortorder ) VALUES
( #{obj.branchid}, #{obj.memberid}, ${obj.dayofweek}, ${obj.method}, ${obj.hour}, ${obj.sortorder} )

INSERT INTO ttokssaemdb.runtimeplan ( branchid, memberid, dayofweek, method, hour, sortorder ) SELECT mp.branchid, mp.memberid, mp.dayofweek, mp.method, mp.hour, mp.sortorder FROM ttokssaemdb.masterplan mp
AND mp.memberid = #{memberid}

INSERT INTO ttokssaemdb.runtimeplan ( branchid, memberid, dayofweek, method, hour, sortorder ) SELECT mp.branchid, mp.memberid, mp.dayofweek, mp.method, mp.hour, mp.sortorder FROM ttokssaemdb.masterplan mp
AND mp.dayofweek = ${dayofweek}

INSERT INTO ttokssaemdb.runtimeplan ( branchid, memberid, dayofweek, method, hour, sortorder ) VALUES
